name: s89-stop-gate-deleted-file-clears-file-check
setup_commands: export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='{TMPROOT}'; printf '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":"%s"}}' '{TMPROOT}/src/a.sh' | bash '{KIT_ROOT}/.claude/hooks/quality-gate.sh' >/dev/null 2>&1; rm src/a.sh
notes: Counterpart to s88: a per-file check's failure goes away with the file — deleting a broken file leaves nothing to verify.
